name: Keman
scene: An elegant amber and gold violin with a separate bow stands against flowing blue and teal acoustic-wave bands.
notes: Design sheet only; target 82–122 panes. Violin and bow use the warm pair; background uses the cool pair. Referenced vitray_fox.png and vitray_lighthouse.png for style and motif_violin-junctions.webp for subject. Visually reviewed and regenerated once to simplify fingerboard, remove open scroll/f-hole strokes and restore white exterior. Remaining doubts: subtle fill shading persists; narrow bow and C-bout strips, small peg connectors, some same-colour neighbours and possible four-way contacts near the bow ends and lower body require attention during tracing. Pane count and production geometry are not certified. No game catalogue changes.
